blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robust scene understanding under varying environmental conditions is essential for safe autonomous driving. While cameras and LiDAR degrade in adverse weather and poor lighting, Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave (FMCW) spinning radar provides dependable 360° perception at extended ranges with minimal compute cost. However, real-time FMCW radar scene understanding is challenging due to complex signal returns, limited temporal resolution, and scarce annotated datasets. We introduce StreamRPS, a novel framework for streaming FMCW radar panoptic segmentation, comprising an automated label-generation pipeline via LiDAR scene completion and a real-time streaming network for semantic and panoptic segmentation. Our encoder-decoder streaming architecture comprises a radar-specific hierarchical Transformer encoder and task-specific decoders for semantic or panoptic prediction. Our encoder introduces a stem to capture range-dependent signatures, anisotropic patch embeddings to preserve angular resolution, and axial polar attention to separately model the periodic azimuth and bounded range axes. We further introduce azimuth roll rotation augmentation to simulate ego-vehicle rotation during training. Comprehensive experiments on the SAX and BOREAS datasets validate both our auto-labeling methodology and streaming segmentation network against established baselines. We outperform the strongest baseline by at least 1.4pp while processing sectors at over 400 FPS in a 4-sector streaming setting. We additionally provide manual annotations for 100 SAX radar scans, enabling independent evaluation of the entire framework.
blocks.zh: 在不同环境条件下对现场的牢固理解对于安全自主驾驶至关重要。 虽然相机和LiDAR在恶劣天气和灯光差的情况下会退化,但频率调制的连续-行走(FMCW)旋转雷达以最小的计算成本提供可信赖的360°感知力。 然而,由于信号返回复杂,时间分辨率有限,以及附加说明的数据集稀缺,实时FMCW雷达场景理解具有挑战性. 我们介绍了StreamRPS,这是流取FMCW雷达泛光分片的一个新框架,它包括一个通过LiDAR场景完成的自动标签生成管道和一个语义和泛光分片的实时流取网络。 我们的编码器-解码器流线架构包括一个雷达专用分级变形器编码器和任务专用解码器,用于语义或泛光学预测. 我们的编码器引入了一种干来捕捉依赖射程的签名,异同位素的补丁嵌入来保存角分辨率,轴极注意将周期方位角和边距的射程轴分别建模. 我们进一步采用方位角滚动旋转增强法,以模拟训练期间自已车辆自转。 SAX和BOREAS数据集的全面试验验证了我们的自动标签方法以及按既定基线进行分流的网络。 在4个区段的流线环境中,我们处理部门超过400个FPS时,我们至少比最强的基线高出1.4pp。 我们还为100个SAX雷达扫描提供人工说明,以便能够对整个框架进行独立评价。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Precise environmental perception is essential for autonomous vehicles to navigate safely [ 1 ] . This perception relies on sensor data from cameras, LiDAR, and radar, each offering distinct capabilities. However, cameras are sensitive to extreme lighting, and both cameras and LiDAR can suffer degraded performance in adverse weather, including rain, snow, and fog. In contrast, Frequency-Modulated Continuous-Wave (FMCW) radar offers greater resilience to these conditions, making it a promising modality for dense scene understanding. In particular, spinning FMCW radar provides 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} angular coverage from a single sensor while maintaining low data-transfer bandwidth and memory requirements [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 精确的环境感知对于自主车辆安全地通航[1]至关重要. 这种感知依赖于相机,LiDAR,和雷达的传感器数据,它们都提供了独特的能力. 然而相机对极端照明敏感,相机和LiDAR在恶劣天气,包括雨,雪,雾等情况下都可能发生性能退化. 相形之下,频率相变相相相变相相相变相(FMCW)雷达能增强抗御这些条件的能力,使它成为密集的场景理解的有希望的模式. 尤其是旋转的FMCW雷达从单个传感器中提供360QQ360QCirc}角覆盖,同时保持低数据传输带宽和内存要求[2].

blocks.en: Despite these sensing advantages, the complexity and noise characteristics of FMCW radar make manual annotation for training segmentation models prohibitively expensive [ 3 ] . Existing approaches therefore rely on camera [ 3 , 4 ] or LiDAR [ 5 ] data for supervision. However, camera-based supervision is constrained by limited viewing angles, while sparse LiDAR measurements leave many regions of the radar grid unlabeled. To address these limitations, we leverage LiDAR scene completion to generate dense radar annotations. The resulting annotations cover 8 8 - 12 12 semantic classes, exceeding the 3 3 - 4 4 classes used in previous studies [ 3 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些感知优势,但FMCW雷达的复杂性和噪声特性使得培训分块模型的人工注释过于昂贵[3]. 因此,现有办法依靠相机[3、4]或LiDAR[5]数据进行监督。 然而,以相机为主的监控受到有限取景角度的限制,而稀少的LiDAR测量使得雷达网格的许多区域没有被标记. 为了克服这些局限性,我们利用LiDAR场景的完成来生成密集的雷达说明. 由此产生的说明涵盖8个8-12个12个语义班,超过了以前研究中使用的3个3-4个4个班[3个、5个、6个、7个]。

blocks.en: Beyond dense supervision, effective radar segmentation requires architectures tailored to the sensor’s distinct measurement characteristics. Existing approaches address these requirements through specialized convolutional and attention mechanisms [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] . However, many of these methods rely on Doppler velocity information, which is often unavailable in spinning FMCW radar data. A further challenge stems from the reliance of existing spinning-radar segmentation approaches on complete 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} scans. At relatively low scan rates ( 4 4\text{\,}\, Hz), waiting for a complete sweep delays predictions. Streaming-capable architectures instead process incoming angular sectors throughout scan acquisition, enabling scene updates before the sweep is complete. Furthermore, to the best of our knowledge, prior work has not explored panoptic segmentation for spinning FMCW radar. Panoptic segmentation distinguishes individual objects within semantic categories through instance-level identifiers [ 11 ] , providing object-level information for motion forecasting and navigation decisions. We therefore propose a specialized streaming architecture that supports both semantic and panoptic scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 除了密集的监管外,有效的雷达分解需要适合传感器不同测量特性的架构。 现有办法通过专门演变和注意机制解决这些要求[8、9、10]。 然而,许多这些方法都依赖于多普勒速度信息,在旋转的FMCW雷达数据中往往无法获得这些信息. 另一项挑战来自现有的旋转-弧分化方法对完整的360-360-Circ}扫描的依赖。 以相对较低的扫描率(4 4\text ~,~), Hz),等待完整的扫荡延迟预测. 可流动的架构代替在整个扫描获取过程中处理所接入的角扇区,在扫描完成前允许场景更新. 此外,据我们所知,先前的工作尚未探索光学分解,用于转动FMCW雷达。 泛光分解通过实例级识别符来区分语义类中的单个物体[11],为运动预测和导航决定提供对象级信息. 因此,我们建议建立一个专门的流体结构,支持对语义和全景的理解。

blocks.en: We present StreamRPS ( Stream ing R adar P anoptic S egmentation), a framework for generating dense radar annotations and enabling streaming semantic and panoptic scene understanding (Fig. 1 ). Our labeling pipeline leverages the pre-trained LiDAR scene completion network PaSCo [ 12 ] to infer dense scene geometry and semantics from sparse LiDAR observations. We align these predictions with the radar’s sequential acquisition through azimuth-based synchronization, then construct and refine instance annotations in polar radar coordinates. For streaming segmentation, we propose an encoder-decoder architecture comprising a radar-specific hierarchical Transformer encoder and task-specific decoders for semantic or panoptic prediction. Our encoder introduces a stem that combines positional information, directional filtering, and temporal feature weighting to capture range-dependent radar signatures. Anisotropic patch embeddings retain finer angular resolution, while axial polar attention distinguishes the periodic azimuth axis from the bounded range axis. We complement these encoder contributions with azimuth roll augmentation, which simulates ego-vehicle rotation through circular shifts during training.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍StreamRP(流出R dar P anoptic S分块),这是一个生成密集雷达说明并促成流出语义和泛光学场景理解的框架(图1)。 我们的标注管道利用了经过预先训练的LiDAR场景完成网络PASCO[12],从稀少的LiDAR观测中推断出密集的场景几何和语义. 我们把这些预测与雷达通过方位角同步的相继获取一致,然后在极地雷达坐标上构建和完善实例说明。 对于流分化,我们提出一个编码器-解码器架构,由雷达特有的分级变形器编码器和任务特定的解码器组成,用于语义或泛光学预测. 我们的编码器引入了一种干法,结合了位置信息,方向过滤,以及时间特征的加权来捕捉依赖射程的雷达信号. 非同位素补丁嵌入保留了更细的角分辨率,而轴极注意则将周期方位角轴与有界范围轴区分开来. 我们用方位角滚增来补充这些编码器的贡献,这模拟了自制车辆在训练期间通过循环轮班来自转。

blocks.en: We evaluate both the label-generation pipeline and the radar segmentation network on the SAX [ 13 ] and Boreas [ 14 ] datasets. For SAX, we additionally create ground-truth labels by manually annotating 350 350 LiDAR scans and projecting these annotations onto 100 100 radar scenes using sensor calibration. These annotations provide held-out ground truth independent of our automatically generated labels. StreamRPS achieves the highest semantic mIoU among the evaluated baselines across all tested sector configurations and the highest panoptic quality in the four-sector setting on both datasets. The network further maintains real-time inference in both full-scan and streaming settings.
blocks.zh: 我们评价SAX[13]和Boreas[14]数据集上的标签生成管道和雷达分块网络。 对于SAX,我们通过手动注释350个350个LiDAR扫描并使用传感器校正将这些注释投射到100个雷达场景上,额外创建了地上真实的标签. 这些说明提供了与我们自动生成的标签无关的坚固的地面真相。 StreamRPS在所有经过测试的部门配置的被评价基线中实现了最高的语义mIoU,在两个数据集的四个部门设置中实现了最高的全光学质量。 该网络还维持了在全扫描和流线设置中的实时推论。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are: • A novel auto-label generation pipeline for obtaining dense semantic and panoptic FMCW radar labels. • A streaming FMCW radar segmentation network supporting both semantic and panoptic predictions, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on the SAX and Boreas benchmarks. • Manually curated annotations comprising 350 350 LiDAR frames and 100 100 calibrated radar scans from the SAX dataset. • Public release of code and trained models upon acceptance.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Radar Segmentation Label Generation :
To reduce manual annotation effort, existing methods generate radar labels using camera data, LiDAR data, or both. CARRADA [ 3 ] associates mean-shift radar clusters with object categories using camera Mask R-CNN predictions and temporal tracking, yielding sparse annotations and dense object masks. RAMP-CNN [ 15 ] uses camera-based object detection and depth estimation to generate radar training labels. Heidbrink et al. [ 16 ] combine camera segmentation with LiDAR-based object localization for radar annotation. RADIal [ 7 ] uses synchronized camera, LiDAR, and high-definition radar data to annotate vehicles and free space. For spinning FMCW radar, RSS-Net [ 2 ] projects camera predictions onto LiDAR points and transfers their labels to radar using calibration and motion compensation.
blocks.zh:
雷达分解 标签生成 :
为了减少人工注释工作,现有方法利用相机数据,LiDAR数据生成雷达标签,或两者兼而有之. CARRADA [3] 联系人使用相机进行对象分类的平移雷达集群 面具R-CNN预测和时间跟踪,产生稀疏的说明和密集的物体口罩. RAMP-CNN [15]使用相机的物体探测和深度估计生成雷达训练标签. 海德布林克等编. [16] 将相机分片与基于LiDAR的物体局部化相结合,用于雷达注释. RADIal [7] 使用同步相机,LiDAR,和高清晰度的雷达数据对车辆和空闲空间进行注释. 对于旋转的FMCW雷达,RSS-Net[2]将相机预测投射到LiDAR点上,并使用校正和运动补偿将其标签转移到雷达上.

blocks.en: LiDAR-only supervision has also been explored for spinning FMCW radar. Li et al. [ 5 ] use pre-trained 3D segmentation models, remove ground points, and group semantic labels into four categories. They refine predictions using DBSCAN clustering and SVD-based structural analysis before projection into radar coordinates. The structural analysis distinguishes building-like surfaces from vegetation to correct mislabeled points. Although these procedures improve label consistency, projection-based supervision can remain spatially incomplete. Our framework instead uses LiDAR scene completion to generate dense semantic and panoptic radar annotations across 8 8 - 12 12 categories.
blocks.zh: 还对旋转的FMCW雷达进行了仅限LiDAR的监控。 李等编. [5]使用预先训练的3D分解模型,去除地分点,将语义标签分入四类. 它们利用DBSCAN集群和基于SVD的结构分析来改进预测,然后投放到雷达坐标. 结构分析将建筑类地表与植被区分开来,以纠正被误标的点. 虽然这些程序提高了标签的一致性,但以投影为基础的监督在空间上仍然不完整。 相反,我们的框架利用LiDAR场景的完成,生成8个8个-12个类别的密集语义和泛光学雷达说明。

blocks.en:
2D Radar Semantic Segmentation :
Spinning FMCW radars have been studied for localization and place recognition [ 17 , 18 ] , while semantic segmentation has received comparatively limited attention. Existing approaches include the U-Net-based method of Li et al. [ 5 ] and RSSNet [ 2 ] , which combines an ASPP-based decoder with class weighting and temporal scan stacking to improve segmentation of small and dynamic objects.
In contrast, extensive research has focused on non-spinning FMCW radars. Many approaches exploit complementary range-angle (RA) and range-Doppler (RD) representations. On CARRADA dataset [ 3 ] , MVNet [ 10 ] uses dual encoder-decoder networks with shared latent features, while TMVA-Net [ 10 ] adds temporal aggregation through 3D convolutions.
PeakConv [ 9 ] introduces peak-inspired convolutional receptive fields, which AdaPKC [ 19 ] adapts to varying radar responses.
Transformer-based approaches include TransRSS [ 20 ] , TransRadar [ 8 ] with adaptive directional attention and class-agnostic localization supervision, and TARSS-Net [ 21 ] with learned temporal relations.
These methods collectively rely on Doppler information via RD representations. For the related task of panoptic segmentation, SemRaFiner [ 22 ] operates on sparse radar point clouds and also uses Doppler information. Extracting Doppler from spinning FMCW radar, however, remains challenging [ 18 ] , creating a gap between the rich literature on non-spinning radars and the underexplored semantic understanding of spinning systems. We bridge this gap by establishing that high-quality panoptic and semantic segmentation is possible without Doppler. Critically, this is the first work to tackle panoptic segmentation for FMCW radar.
blocks.zh:
二维 雷达语义分解:
已研究了自旋FMCW雷达的定位和位置识别[17,18],而语义分解则受到相对有限的关注. 现有方法有:以Li等人[5]和RSSNet[2]为主的U-Net方法,将基于ASPP的解码器与分级权重和时间扫描堆放相结合来改进小和动态对象的分化.
相形之下,广泛的研究侧重于非自旋FMCW雷达. 许多方法利用了互补的射程角(RA)和射程多普勒(RD)的表示. 在CARRADA数据集 [3]上,MVNet [10] 使用具有共同潜在特性的双编码器-解码器网络,而TMVA-Net [10] 通过3D分解来增加时间聚合.

这些方法通过RD表达方式共同依赖多普勒信息. 对于泛光分解的相关任务,SemRaFiner[22]在稀疏的雷达点云上运行并也使用多普勒信息. 然而,从旋转的FMCW雷达中提取多普勒仍然具有挑战性[18],造成关于非旋转雷达的丰富文献与对旋转系统的语义理解不足之间出现差距。 我们通过确定没有多普勒就有可能实现高质量的泛光学和语义分解来弥补这一差距。 关键的是,这是处理FMCW雷达光学分解的第一个工作。

blocks.en:
Streaming Segmentation for Spinning Sensors :
While streaming segmentation has not yet been explored for spinning FMCW radar, prior work in LiDAR perception has investigated this direction. Han et al. [ 23 ] introduce streaming object detection, while STROBE [ 24 ] processes LiDAR packets using a bird’s-eye-view (BEV) convolutional backbone and multi-scale spatial memory. However, representing wedge-shaped sectors on Cartesian grids can introduce computation over empty regions. Thus, PolarStream [ 25 ] adopts polar coordinate representations. It uses polar pillars and multi-scale context padding from neighboring sectors for object detection and semantic segmentation. PARTNER [ 26 ] addresses polar feature distortion through attention-based realignment for 3D object detection, while PFCF [ 27 ] combines a Mamba-based polar streaming backbone with a sector-feature buffer and a Cartesian full-scan pathway. Building on these LiDAR streaming foundations, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first streaming semantic and panoptic segmentation framework for spinning FMCW radar.
blocks.zh:
旋转传感器的分流:
虽然尚未为旋转的FMCW雷达探索流分化,但先前在LiDAR感知方面的工作已经调查了这个方向. 韩等. [23] 引入流体物体探测,而STROBE [24] 则利用鸟眼观(BEV)的演化骨干和多尺度空间记忆处理LiDAR包. 然而,在笛卡尔网格上代表楔形区段可以引入对空区域的计算. 因此,"极地史"[25]采用了极地坐标表示. 它使用从相邻扇区的极地柱和多尺度上下文粘接来进行对象检测和语义分解. PARNER [26] 通过基于注意力的调整3D对象检测解决了极地特征扭曲问题,而PFCF [27] 结合了以曼巴为主的极地流体主干线,并配有扇形地貌缓冲器和笛卡尔全扫描路径. 基于这些LiDAR流线地基,我们以我们所知的最好情况,介绍了第一个流线语义和泛光分解框架,用于旋转FMCW雷达。

blocks.en: III Technical Approach
blocks.zh: 三. 技术方法

blocks.en: In this section, we present the methodology of StreamRPS for generating dense semantic and panoptic radar annotations by leveraging a pre-trained LiDAR scene completion network. We also introduce a streaming-capable FMCW radar segmentation network that delivers semantic or panoptic predictions in real time, as shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了StreamRPS通过利用一个经过预先培训的LiDAR场景完成网络生成密集语义和泛光学雷达说明的方法。 我们还引入了能流能FMCW雷达分块网络,实时提供语义或泛光学预测,如图2所示。

We then apply azimuth roll rotation to augment radar scans before processing radar sectors with our streaming network. Key novelties include our RadarStem and Axial Polar Attention. Semantic and panoptic decoders decode the resulting features. Cross-entropy, Dice, and L 1 L_{1} losses are applied per decoder, as appropriate.

blocks.en: III-A Cross-Modal Dense Label Generation
blocks.zh: 三-A 跨摩多尔 深色标签生成

blocks.en:
We generate semantic and panoptic radar labels by leveraging cross-modal LiDAR supervision. Given a LiDAR point cloud P ∈ ℝ K × 4 P\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times 4} of K K points ( x , y , z , i ) (x,y,z,i) , we first produce a dense, scene-completed voxel grid using the LiDAR scene completion network PaSCo [ 12 ] .
Specifically, PaSCo first applies a sparse 3D generative U-Net followed by a Mask2Former decoder [ 28 ] to produce panoptic scene completion (PSC) on occupied voxel regions.
We direct readers to the original work for implementation details [ 12 ] .
We employ PaSCo trained on SemanticKITTI [ 29 ] , which generates voxel grids D ∈ ℝ 256 × 256 × 32 D\in\mathbb{R}^{256\times 256\times 32} at 0.2 ​ m 0.2m resolution.
To achieve extended spatial coverage while maintaining consistent voxel granularity, we decompose the LiDAR point cloud into quadrants and perform scene completion on each independently. Quadrant tiling is performed in voxel space to avoid overlap, and the resulting voxels are merged into a unified grid U ∈ ℝ 512 × 512 × 32 U\in\mathbb{R}^{512\times 512\times 32} . We then convert these 3D voxel representations to Cartesian BEV labels V B ​ E ​ V V_{BEV} by collapsing along the z-axis and retaining, for each ground-plane cell, the label at the highest occupied voxel.

A fundamental challenge in cross-modal supervision is temporal misalignment arising from differing sensor acquisition rates. Our FMCW radar operates at 4 Hz 4\text{\,}\mathrm{Hz} while LiDAR operates at 10 Hz 10\text{\,}\mathrm{Hz} , creating temporal inconsistencies, particularly for dynamic objects. We address this through an azimuth-based synchronization strategy that mirrors the radar’s rotating acquisition pattern. For each azimuth in a radar scan, we select the temporally nearest LiDAR scan Y c ​ a ​ r ​ t l Y_{cart}^{l} , effectively compositing V B ​ E ​ V V_{BEV} from multiple consecutive LiDAR frames to generate Y c ​ a ​ r ​ t Y_{cart} , a Cartesian label for every radar image.

Next, we convert the labels from Cartesian Y c ​ a ​ r ​ t Y_{cart} to polar coordinates Y p ​ o ​ l ​ a ​ r ∈ ℝ A × R Y_{polar}\in\mathbb{R}^{A\times R} via range/azimuth resolution mapping, matching the native polar representation X p ​ o ​ l ​ a ​ r X_{polar} of the radar image. We leverage polar representations for two reasons. First, prior radar segmentation work has shown that polar representations yield superior results compared to Cartesian bird’s-eye-view (BEV) representations [ 25 ] . Second, polar representations are particularly well suited to streaming: slicing along the azimuth (height) axis yields fully populated, rectangular slices. In contrast, slicing a Cartesian BEV scan produces sparse, wedge-shaped “cake slices,” where only a fraction of each slice contains valid data [ 25 ] .

blocks.en: Although PSC provides instance-level panoptic annotations, we find them unreliable in the polar radar frame. When mapped to the sensor’s coordinate system, instances are often oversized because small errors in the per-pixel estimates inflate the projected labels on the radar grid. Further, an object straddling the 0°/360° angular seam (e.g., spanning 350°-10°) has its pixels split across the two ends of the angular range.

This can nonetheless produce fragmented or over-extended instances: a single object’s return may split into several spatially disjoint components, or a projection inaccuracy may merge it into a thin streak spanning much of the frame. We address fragmentation and over-extension by restricting each instance to its single largest connected component, discarding disconnected fragments without altering any retained pixel. Further, we discard instances with a pixel area below 25 25 or a bounding-box height below 4 4 , which typically correspond to spurious, non-physical detections.

Then, we apply our novel azimuth roll augmentation which simulates ego-vehicle rotation during training (Sec. III-B3 ). blocks.en: III-B 4 Network Architecture
blocks.zh: 网络结构

blocks.en: We design a tailored Mix Transformer radar-encoder for streaming polar inputs. Our encoder introduces a stem (RadarStem) that combines positional, directional, and temporal cues to capture range-dependent radar signatures. This is followed by anisotropic patch embeddings that retain angular resolution. Our novel axial polar attention then attends separately to the periodic azimuth axis and the bounded range axis, followed by a radar-adapted Mix-FFN. Finally, we append semantic and panoptic decoders. In contrast to the standard formulation of Mix Transformer [ 30 ] , which assumes Cartesian image geometry and doesn’t model temporal continuity, our design captures the periodic azimuthal structure and streaming nature of polar radar sweeps.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一台量身定制的Mix变形器雷达编码器,用于流出极地输入. 我们的编码器引入了一种干法(RadarStem),结合了位置,方向和时间提示来捕捉依赖射程的雷达信号. 随后是保留角分辨率的异同位素补丁嵌入. 我们的小说轴极的注意,然后分别关注周期方位角轴和有界范围轴,然后是雷达适应的Mix-FFN. 最后,我们附带语义和泛光解码器。 与Mix Transformer [30] 的标准配方相对,它假定笛卡尔图像几何,而不模拟时间连续性,我们的设计抓住了极地雷达扫射的周期方位结构和流线性质。

blocks.en:
RadarStem : Polar images are not translation invariant because objects’ representations depend on their range and azimuth from the ego-vehicle. We provide positional awareness by appending normalized embeddings [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] to the R R and A A axes, producing X p ​ o ​ l ​ a ​ r S n , t + ∈ ℝ A / N × R × ( t + 2 ) X^{S_{n,t+}}_{polar}\in\mathbb{R}^{A/N\times R\times(t+2)} . This ensures the model understands that identical features at different ranges have distinct physical implications.
Radar artifacts also exhibit directional characteristics such as azimuthal smearing and range-dependent reflection profiles. Standard dense convolutions are isotropic, making them unsuitable for capturing these anisotropic patterns. We employ asymmetric factorized depthwise convolutions with parallel radar-aligned filters where a 1 × 5 1\times 5 kernel captures range profiles and a 5 × 1 5\times 1 kernel captures azimuthal smearing. This approach reduces parameters and computation while maintaining receptive field coverage and improving feature expressiveness.
We compress the t + 2 t+2 -channel representation to t t channels via 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution and a Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) block [ 31 ] . The SE block applies channel-wise feature recalibration through global pooling and a bottleneck MLP. Since our channels encode temporal steps, this acts as a temporal attention mechanism, dynamically weighting the importance of historical versus current sweeps based on scene motion.

blocks.en:
Axial Polar Attention : Standard self-attention mechanisms for dense prediction rely on aggressive 2D spatial reduction for efficiency and assume flat Cartesian geometry. However, this corrupts fine-grained radar signatures and ignores its inherent periodicity.
We introduce Axial Polar Attention, a radar-tailored factorization that exploits the sensor’s geometric characteristics. Azimuth (Height) Attention computes self-attention along the angular axis with circular padding on Key and Value tensors, explicitly modeling the 360° periodicity and enabling seamless attention across the 0°/360° boundary. In contrast, Range (Width) Attention applies standard zero padding to respect radar’s fixed sensing bounds. This asymmetric padding strategy is novel to radar and fundamentally differs from standard axial attention.
Crucially, both branches are computed in parallel, and their outputs are summed to yield the final representation. This preserves computational efficiency for real-time streaming.
blocks.zh:
轴地注意:密集预测的标准自发机制依赖于主动的2D空间减速来提高效率并假设平坦的笛卡尔几何. 然而,这腐蚀了精细的雷达信号,忽视了它固有的周期性.
我们引入轴极注意,一种利用传感器几何特征的雷达专用分解。 Azimmoth (H8) 注意计算出沿角轴自留心,在键和值等分数器上以圆贴出,明确模拟出360°周期并允许无缝的注意跨越0°/360°边界. 反之,Range(Width) Content应用了标准零加载来尊重雷达的固定感知界限. 这种不对称的垫地策略对雷达来说是新颖的,从根本上不同于标准的轴心注意力.
关键的是,两个处都是平行计算的,其产出被汇总以产生最后的代表。 这保持了实时流线的计算效率.

blocks.en:
Polar Mix-FFN :
Positional information is implicitly encoded through convolutional zero-padding within the Mix-FFN layer of our encoder. Rather than the standard 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution with uniform zero-padding, we apply asymmetric padding tailored to polar geometry: constant zero padding along the range axis to respect fixed sensing bounds, and circular padding along the azimuth axis to enforce angular periodicity. This wraps the image around the 0 ∘ 0^{\circ} / 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} boundary, ensuring convolutional receptive fields accurately capture physical adjacency across the sweep boundary. This is only physically meaningful for the first and last sector under slicing, where the sector edge coincides with the true azimuth wraparound. For middle sectors, circular padding instead serves as a simplifying approximation, since these boundaries do not correspond to a genuine angular discontinuity.

Semantic Decoder :
For decoding, we employ an All-MLP design that avoids expensive handcrafted components by relying solely on MLP layers. This is feasible given our Transformer encoder’s large effective receptive field. The decoder unifies multi-level features, upsamples to 1 4 \frac{1}{4} of the input resolution, concatenates them, and applies MLPs to generate the segmentation mask.

blocks.en: IV Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 四. 实验评价

blocks.en: We evaluate StreamRPS against nine baselines and provide a comprehensive ablation study to demonstrate the significance of our contributions. We first present an overview of the datasets used, followed by the experimental settings, performance results, and ablations.
blocks.zh: 我们对照9个基线对StreamRPS进行评估,并进行全面的研究,以表明我们的贡献的重要性。 我们首先概述了所使用的数据集,然后是实验设置、性能结果和模拟。

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on the SAX and Boreas datasets. SAX : The SAX dataset [ 13 ] was collected in the UK using a Navtech CTS350-X FMCW scanning radar operating at 4 Hz 4\text{\,}\mathrm{Hz} , paired with a Velodyne HDL-64E LiDAR. The dataset comprises 20,875 radar scans with a maximum range of 163 m 163\text{\,}\mathrm{m} , each rendered as a 400 × 3768 400\times 3768 polar image. Since the LiDAR sensor matches SemanticKITTI, we directly apply PaSCo pretrained on SemanticKITTI within our auto-labeling approach. In addition to the generated labels, we hand-labeled 350 350 LiDAR scans with [ 36 ] , yielding 100 100 annotated radar images spanning 12 classes: car, two-wheeled vehicle, other vehicle, person, rider, road, pavement, building, fence, vegetation, terrain, and pole.
blocks.zh: 我们对SAX和Boreas数据集的方法进行评估。 SAX:SAX数据集 [13]在英国被采集,使用一台以4Hz 4\text ~,}\mathrm{Hz}运行的Navtech CTS350-X FMCW扫描雷达,并配有一台Velodyne HDL-64E LiDAR. 数据集由20,875个雷达扫描组成,最大范围为163 m 163\text{\,}\-mathrm{m},每个被渲染成400×3768400\times 3768极地图像. 由于LiDAR传感器与SemanticKITTI相匹配,我们直接将PASCo在SemanticKITTI上预先应用到我们的自动标签方法中. 除了生成的标签之外,我们手贴了350个350个LiDAR扫描带[36],产生了100个附加说明的雷达图像,覆盖了12个类别:汽车、双轮车辆、其他车辆、人、骑手、公路、人行道、建筑、围栏、植被、地形和柱子。

blocks.en: Boreas : The Boreas dataset [ 14 ] was recorded in Canada with a Navtech CIR304-H scanning radar ( 4 Hz 4\text{\,}\mathrm{Hz} ) alongside a 128-channel Velodyne Alpha-Prime LiDAR. Since its LiDAR intensity distribution differs from that of the HDL-64E used in SemanticKITTI, we normalize Boreas intensities to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] prior to auto-labeling. The selected dataset contains 16,450 radar scans from four randomly chosen days with moderate-to-good weather conditions, each represented as a 400 × 3371 400\times 3371 polar image and automatically annotated via auto-labeling into 8 classes: car, two-wheeled vehicle, person, obstacle, terrain, pole, pavement, and road. We merge the original lorry, truck, fence, and building classes into a single obstacle class because this sensor produces inconsistent LiDAR predictions.

blocks.en: IV-B Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: IV-B 实验设置

blocks.en:
We divide each dataset into training, validation, and test sets using a 70%-15%-15% split, defined along distinct chronological and geographical regions to ensure an unbiased benchmark of generalization performance. We crop polar images to 400 × 1024 400\times 1024 , discarding the range beyond this point, as our LiDAR-based labels extend only to 1024 1024 . We use a temporal window of t = 3 t=3 scans, together with roll rotation augmentation applied with probability p = 0.7 p=0.7 and vertical flipping. Our Mix Transformer has feature dimensions F 1 F_{1} , F 2 F_{2} , F 3 F_{3} , and F 4 F_{4} of 32 32 , 64 64 , 160 160 , and 256 256 . To address class imbalance, we set the loss weights α = 1 \alpha=1 and β = 3 \beta=3 . We train for 80 ​ k 80k iterations using AdamW with a batch size of 16 16 , weight decay of 0.01 0.01 , an initial learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the backbone and 10 − 2 10^{-2} for the segmentation head. We apply a 1500 1500 -iteration linear warm-up, followed by Multi-Step decay by a factor of 10 10 at iterations 60 ​ k 60k and 72 ​ k 72k .
To benchmark the effectiveness of our proposed method, we evaluate segmentation accuracy using mean Intersection over Union (mIoU), and panoptic performance using Panoptic Quality (PQ), Segmentation Quality (SQ), and Recognition Quality (RQ) [ 11 ] . Additionally, we measure Frames Per Second (FPS) on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti GPU.

blocks.en: IV-C Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 四-C 量化结果

blocks.en: In Tab. I , we compare StreamRPS with three radar-specific architectures and three general semantic segmentation models on full scans ( N = 1 N=1 ) and on sub-sectors of 2 2 , 4 4 , 8 8 , 16 16 , and 32 32 sectors per scan, using each method’s published code and settings. We modify radar-specific networks to use range-azimuth data only. Mask2Former relies on a frozen DINOv2 backbone, while the remaining models are trained end-to-end. We guide the Cross-Entropy loss with pre-computed class weights to address class imbalance, and tune the learning rate and batch size to maximize performance for each model. We do not evaluate Mask2Former and SegFormer at 16 16 and 32 32 sectors, as the resulting sector heights fall below the minimum spatial dimensions supported by their published implementations, and supporting them would require method-specific transformations altering the native sector representation.

blocks.en: We observe that StreamRPS outperforms all baselines across all settings. While the margin at full-scan resolution is modest ( 0.06 0.06 pp on Boreas and 0.79 0.79 pp on SAX), the benefit of our method is particularly evident at 8 8 sectors, where we outperform the second-best method by 1.54 1.54 pp on Boreas and 3 3 pp on SAX. We attribute this to our axial polar attention and custom patch embedding, which remain effective even at smaller sector sizes. For SAX, performance is even maintained close to the full-scan level. We observe that all methods drop in performance as sector size decreases, since detecting objects becomes harder with insufficient context or only partial views. Nonetheless, StreamRPS remains robust, achieving above 21.8 21.8 mIoU even when processing sectors as small as 12 × 1024 12\times 1024 ( 32 32 sectors) which enables prediction rates of up to 128 128 Hz for a 4 4 Hz sensor. We further analyze the compute-efficiency of our method in comparison to the baselines in Sec. IV-E .

blocks.en: We further note that all methods achieve high scores on background classes such as road, pavement, terrain, vegetation, building, and fences on full scans (mIoU > 40 >40 ), while small, thin objects (obj S ) such as two-wheeled vehicles, persons, and poles consistently score below 10 10 mIoU. We attribute this to their limited occurrence combined with the inherent difficulty of distinguishing small objects in radar, an imbalance that loss re-weighting alone could not resolve. Our axial attention’s dedicated modeling of range and azimuth generally benefits small-object categories, except on SAX, where Mask2Former’s per-instance queries and DINOv2 pretraining better preserve its especially fine-grained classes. Large objects (obj L ) perform reasonably well ( 30 30 - 50 50 mIoU). However, Mask2Former outperforms StreamRPS on large objects on Boreas, as its global, query-based cross-attention captures long-range coherence that our more localized, compute-efficient design achieves only to a limited extent.

blocks.en: IV-D Inference Performance
blocks.zh: 四-D 推断性能

blocks.en:
Our reported inference speeds reflect network throughput measured with TensorRT and exclude sensor I/O and pre- and post-processing overhead. Tab. III reports inference speed (FPS), memory consumption, and latency percentiles. Mask2Former is significantly slower than the other tested methods in the full-scan and 4-sector streaming settings while SegFormer and StreamRPS achieve comparable inference speeds at full-scan resolution. In the 4-sector setting, however, SegFormer attains the highest throughput as its spatial reduction attention scales down more favorably at small inputs than our dual-branch axial attention, whose fixed overhead from circular padding is amortized less effectively at small sector sizes. Despite this, StreamRPS outperforms SegFormer by 4 4 pp while remaining highly efficient in absolute terms, comfortably exceeding real-time requirements even at the fine streaming granularity.
In terms of memory, Mask2Former requires over 9 × 9\times as much as our method, with its peak usage dominated by engine size and largely independent of input resolution in our setup, whereas RSSNet, SegFormer, and StreamRPS all show reduced memory usage at smaller sector sizes. Across all methods, the tight spread between p50 and p99 latencies indicates stable, predictable inference times with minimal variation.

blocks.en: IV-E 1 Training Label Generation
blocks.zh: IV-E 1 培训标签生成

blocks.en: We show the influence of including PaSCo in our auto-labeling pipeline. Tab. IV compares training on auto-labels including PaSCo scene completion against sparse, pointwise labels predicted directly by its underlying backbone, WaffleIron [ 38 ] . We evaluate both approaches on our hand-labeled test set and the dense auto-label test set. Our proposed auto-labeling approach substantially outperforms WaffleIron on the hand-labeled test set, improving results by at least 1.46 1.46 pp and showing that dense labels considerably improve prediction capabilities, while training with only a sparse signal hurts the network. Similarly, training on sparse WaffleIron labels generalizes poorly to the dense evaluation setting, with a gap of at least 9.2 9.2 pp, highlighting the importance of dense supervision for robust performance across label granularities.

We present qualitative results for semantic and panoptic segmentation in Fig. 3 . For semantic segmentation, we compare with SegFormer, whose comparable FPS highlights the resulting quality disparity, and for panoptic segmentation, with the strongest baseline, Mask2Former. Panels (a, e) show full-image predictions on Boreas and SAX, respectively, while (b, f) show 4-sector streaming splits on the same datasets. In (a, b, f), SegFormer confuses street and sidewalk, whereas StreamRPS predicts both classes correctly. Panel (b) further highlights the smooth transition between sectors achieved by StreamRPS, while in (e), our method correctly segments vegetation, whereas the baseline confuses it with sidewalk.
For panoptic segmentation, we observe that Mask2Former commonly misses cars in (c, d) for Boreas while it commonly predicts street for sidewalk in (d) and building in (h). Further, both models struggle to detect small objects such as bicycle and person in (g).

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We present StreamRPS, a novel approach to radar labeling and streaming segmentation. We first generate dense labels via LiDAR scene completion, yielding richer supervision for improved segmentation. We then introduce a lightweight, radar-specific transformer architecture for streaming semantic and panoptic segmentation, enabling fast sub-scan predictions. Our contributions include tailored augmentation, a radar-specific patch embedding and stem architecture, and a novel attention formulation that exploits range-azimuth polar representations. Experiments on the Boreas and SAX datasets show that our method outperforms others in both performance and compute requirements for panoptic and semantic segmentation across various sector sizes. This is the first work to address streaming and panoptic segmentation for FMCW radar. We hope our dataset, auto-labeling pipeline, and architecture will serve as a foundation for future research on real-time radar scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍StreamRPS,一种处理雷达标签和分流的新型方法。 我们首先通过LiDAR场景的完成来产生密集的标签,从而产生更丰富的监督来改进分化. 然后我们引入了轻量级,雷达专用的变压器架构来进行流体语义和泛光分解,使得能进行快分扫描预测. 我们的贡献包括量体裁衣的增强、雷达专用的补丁嵌入和干线结构,以及利用射程-半径极值表示的新注意力表述。 对Boreas和SAX数据集的实验表明,我们的方法在性能和计算不同部门规模的泛光学和语义分解要求方面都比其他方法好。 这是处理FMCW雷达的流线和泛光分片的第一项工作。 我们希望我们的数据集,自动标签管道,和架构将成为未来实时雷达场景理解研究的基础.
